about: Corpus B: clinical details (obstetric formula, caesareans, blood group, conditions, results, medicines), as Chrome writes them (fake data).

format.case: { id, region, careType, text, tags?, expected: { values, confirm?, questions?, notes?, noValue?, allow? }, alt?, why? }
format.values: Form paths that must be filled with exactly this value (see voiceRegions.json). A scalar given as a list is a list of acceptable answers. { "match": "regex" } compares with a case-insensitive regular expression.
format.confirm: { path: { value, ask } }: blood group, Rh and reactive/positive results go to the confirmation card. Correct if filled with value, or left empty with a question matching ask. A tick is written as its own path, e.g. "medical.conditions.hiv": { "value": true, "ask": "HIV" }.
format.allow: Paths that may be filled or left empty (not scored).
format.alt: Another acceptable expected result for an ambiguous case.
format.strict: Any path filled that is not in values, confirm or allow counts as WRONG (an extra tick, note, other condition or field).
